checks.title: Confirm the goal and owner
checks.instructions: Record the named owner, authorized website, offer, audience, market, primary visitor action, and excluded actions.

checks.title: Choose a useful metric
checks.instructions: Record the metric definition and source, plus a comparable baseline or an explicit baseline-first start date.

checks.title: Bind the Crew team
checks.instructions: Record at least two distinct authorized Crew IDs: a strategist with growth-priority-brief/v1 capability and a Search Opportunity Mapper with search-opportunity-list/v1 capability. Inspect the actual selected skills and first-result evidence; an SEO issue specialist alone does not satisfy the search slot.

checks.title: Verify site scope
checks.instructions: Inspect the approved page set or owner export; record crawl boundary, source dates, and known gaps.

checks.title: Verify access
checks.instructions: Test each required Crew's selected skill and source access. Record optional connection decisions without copying credentials.

checks.title: Test selected artifact contracts
checks.instructions: Validate a real sourced growth-priority-brief/v1, then search-opportunity-list/v1 against that exact brief. Validate every selected optional step against the complete upstream chain: approved content brief, page draft, verified publication, distribution plan, and/or traffic readout. Save artifact paths, validator output, and Crew run IDs. Confirm a malformed fixture blocks its consumer step. A draft or pending ship cannot feed distribution or measured outcomes.

checks.title: Review the Automation plan
checks.instructions: Show the actual team, Crew steps, permissions, budget, publication boundary, and activation policy to the owner.

checks.title: Run the first route manually
checks.instructions: Record a bounded manual run with both Crew run IDs, actual artifact paths, validator results, source references, a combined owner review, and visible blockers. Keep the route manual if a validator step is absent or an artifact fails.

checks.title: Track the first reviewed action
checks.instructions: Save stable action ID, source opportunity/finding, owner, approval state, proposed change, success signal, and next check date. Distinguish proposed, approved, drafted, shipped, and measured. If the optional route is selected, record exact page approval, provider publication receipt, live verification, channel approvals and delivery receipts, and comparable measurement windows as separate evidence. A brief, page draft, or unsent distribution plan is not a shipped or measured result.

checks.title: Choose the run policy
checks.instructions: Record manual-only or a reviewed paused trigger with cadence, timezone, concurrency, retries, budget, and notifications. Do not enable it by completing setup.
